IMT Solutions · Enterprise applications

pureIntegration

Three enterprise applications spanning content moderation, asset management, and broadcast monitoring.

Role
Senior Software Engineer II
Organization
IMT Solutions · pureIntegration
Period
Jan 2022 – Jun 2024

Overview

My team developed and maintained three microservice-based applications for pureIntegration. ContentCheck supports AI-powered content moderation, iSource manages infrastructure assets, and LiveEdge monitors television advertisements. The work involved real-time data processing, reporting, and distributed systems.

My contributions

  • Build frontend features and design user interfaces with Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, and Angular Material.
  • Develop Node.js microservices backed by MongoDB, RabbitMQ, and Redis.
  • Design database structures and microservice architecture to support the applications.
  • Gather customer requirements, estimate tasks, and report progress.
  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, and review code with overseas developers.

Performance improvement

I improved one API’s response time from 56 seconds to 10 milliseconds using Redis and parallel processing.

Alongside new feature work, I maintained the existing applications and supported their distributed backend services.
